risk_attitude.moderate: balanced appetite for risk; the client's usual long-run stance
risk_attitude.cautious: after a sell-off or stated nervousness; wants low volatility for now
risk_attitude.growth: open to more equity exposure (for example a growth result on the risk questionnaire)

investing_style.index_only: index funds only; does not pick single stocks
investing_style.index_plus_single_stocks: index funds plus some single stocks bought by the client
investing_style.managed: discretionary advisory account; the bank manages the portfolio

docs.retirement_date: YYYY-MM, or null when there is no plan

_rules.as_of: A claim may carry as_of (ISO date). It is then history and is scored against the truth on as_of. A claim without as_of is the document's current view, scored against the truth on the document's date.
_rules.instrument_type: trades and news carry instrument_type: fund, index_fund or single_stock
